compatibility.schema_version_const: episode and transition records carry schema_version 1.0.0; a breaking change bumps it

notes: The episode schema's producer enum is now arm, banshee, vishwaroop (program ADR-0003, 2026-10-31); schemas are otherwise unchanged from the 2026-10-30 reference release, and schema_version stays 1.0.0 because no record outside the fabricated fixtures existed under the old values. This kit release reformats the reference utilities without changing their semantics, adds the append-only validation ledger (schema + validate.py --ledger), and adds writer.py, a write-once reference exporter.
